deploybot: job=deploy-5256789012 scheduled; preflight at 01:15 UTC. will run prebake, smoke, perf microbench. /status for updates.

deploybot: promoted to 5% at 01:52:10 UTC. holding 6m.

ops: brief kv-miss spike on shard s-9 (+0.12% absolute) resolved after drain; no action.
